ground a plane: After engineers found a crack in one engine, the airline decided to ground a plane for a full safety check.
工程師發現一具引擎有裂縫後，航空公司決定讓一架飛機停飛，進行全面安全檢查。
be grounded: If you come home after midnight again, you will be grounded and cannot go out with your friends for a month.
如果你再半夜以後才回家，你就會被禁足，一個月不能和朋友出去。
ground an argument in facts: A good debater should always ground an argument in facts and numbers instead of personal feelings.
優秀的辯論者應該總是以事實和數據為論點根據，而不是個人感受。
well grounded: Her worries about the bridge turned out to be well grounded, because engineers later found serious damage underneath it.
她對那座橋的擔憂結果是有充分根據的，因為工程師後來在橋下發現了嚴重損壞。
ground a teenager: Many parents ground a teenager who breaks the family rules by taking away his phone for a week.
許多父母會禁足違反家規的青少年，沒收他的手機一個星期。
grow apart: My best friend and I began to grow apart after she moved to Canada and we stopped writing to each other.
我最好的朋友搬到加拿大、我們不再寫信之後，我們就開始漸行漸遠。
grow on someone: I didn't like the song at first, but it started to grow on me after I heard it a few more times.
我一開始不喜歡這首歌，但多聽了幾次之後就越來越喜歡它了。
grow out of a habit: Most children who bite their nails will grow out of a habit like that by the time they reach high school.
大多數咬指甲的孩子到了高中時，長大後就會戒掉那樣的習慣。
grow a business: With hard work and good advice, she managed to grow a business from a small food stand into three popular restaurants.
靠著努力和好的建議，她成功把事業從一個小吃攤壯大成三家熱門餐廳。
grow into the role: The new class leader was shy at first, but he slowly began to grow into the role as the semester went on.
新班長起初很害羞，但隨著學期進行，他慢慢逐漸勝任這個角色。
grow up: Children who grow up on farms often learn to take care of animals and plants from a very young age.
在農場長大的孩子常常從很小就學會照顧動物和植物。
guarantee success: Talent alone cannot guarantee success; you also need patience, practice, and a little luck to reach your goals.
光有天分無法保證成功；你還需要耐心、練習和一點運氣才能達成目標。
guarantee quality: To guarantee quality, the factory tests every single bottle of milk before it is sent to the supermarkets.
為了保證品質，工廠在每一瓶牛奶送到超市前都會進行檢驗。
guarantee a loan: My uncle agreed to guarantee a loan for my cousin so that the bank would lend him money to buy a car.
我叔叔同意為我表哥的貸款擔保，好讓銀行借錢給他買車。
no guarantee that: There is no guarantee that the concert will go ahead, since a typhoon is expected to hit the city this weekend.
不保證音樂會會照常舉行，因為預計這週末會有颱風侵襲本市。
guard a secret: She promised to guard a secret that her best friend had told her and never shared it with anyone.
她答應為最好的朋友守密，從來沒有告訴任何人那個祕密。
guard against disease: Washing your hands often and getting enough sleep are simple ways to guard against disease during the flu season.
勤洗手和充足睡眠是流感季節預防疾病的簡單方法。
guard one's privacy: Many famous singers try hard to guard their privacy by never posting photos of their homes or families online.
許多知名歌手努力保護隱私，從不在網路上張貼家裡或家人的照片。
guard the prisoner: Two police officers were ordered to guard the prisoner day and night until his trial began next month.
兩名警察奉命日夜看守囚犯，直到下個月開庭為止。
off guard: The teacher's surprise quiz caught the whole class off guard, since nobody had studied the night before.
老師的突襲小考讓全班猝不及防，因為前一晚沒有人讀書。
guide the discussion: As class leader, Amy will guide the discussion and make sure everyone gets a chance to share their opinions.
身為班長，艾咪會引導討論，確保每個人都有機會分享意見。
be guided by principles: A fair judge must always be guided by principles of honesty and justice rather than by personal feelings.
公正的法官必須總是以誠實與正義的原則為依歸，而非個人感情。
guide tourists: During summer vacation, college students often work part-time to guide tourists around the old streets of Tainan.
暑假期間，大學生常打工帶團，領著遊客逛台南的老街。
guide one's decisions: My parents taught me to let my values guide my decisions, even when making the right choice is difficult.
我父母教我讓自己的價值觀引導決策，即使做出正確的選擇很困難。
gut a building: The fire was so serious that it managed to gut a building completely, leaving only the outside walls standing.
那場大火嚴重到把一棟建築完全燒空，只剩外牆屹立。
gut a fish: Before cooking dinner, my grandfather showed me how to gut a fish and wash the inside with cold water.
在煮晚餐前，祖父示範給我看怎麼清除魚內臟，再用冷水洗淨魚肚。
gut feeling: I had a gut feeling that something was wrong when my brother didn't answer his phone all day.
我哥哥整天都沒接電話時，我直覺有什麼事不對勁。
hate someone's guts: After he spread lies about her online, she said she would hate his guts for the rest of her life.
在他於網路上散播關於她的謊言之後，她說她這輩子都會對他恨之入骨。
